name: timed-tabs
description: Browser extension that puts an expiry timer on tabs and visually signals how close each tab is to expiring.

scripts.start:chrome: npm run build:chrome && web-ext run --target chromium --source-dir dist/chrome
scripts.package: npm run package:firefox && npm run package:chrome
scripts.package:firefox: npm run build:firefox && web-ext build --source-dir dist/firefox --artifacts-dir web-ext-artifacts --overwrite-dest --filename timed-tabs-firefox-$npm_package_version.zip
scripts.package:chrome: npm run build:chrome && web-ext build --source-dir dist/chrome --artifacts-dir web-ext-artifacts --overwrite-dest --filename timed-tabs-chrome-$npm_package_version.zip
